title: pennsylvania-lpm Institutional Actor Record
description: An institution, agency, office, network, or role relevant to a state's curriculum-policy process -- a state education department, a governing board, a regional service agency, a school district, a nonprofit curriculum organization, an advocacy body. Not a person-tracking record: named individuals may appear in `currentHolder` but the record is anchored to the institutional role, which outlives any one office-holder. Modeled directly on deutsche_lp's institutional-actor-record.schema.json -- same shape, actorType vocabulary adapted to US education governance instead of transliterating German terms.

id.description: Provisional, repo-local id. See GOVERNANCE.md -- not an ecosystem-permanent identifier.

jurisdiction.description: ISO-3166-2 style state code (e.g. US-FL) or 'US' for federal/multi-state.

parentActor.description: Id of the actor this one reports into, is a division of, or was convened by, if any.

role.description: What this actor does with respect to curriculum policy specifically -- not a general institutional mission statement.

currentHolder.description: Named individual currently in this role, if applicable and known. Titles/incumbents change -- always check verificationStatus before treating this as current.

crossRepoRefs.description: Added 2026-10-20 across pennsylvania-lpm/pennsylvania-lpm/tennessee-lpm: ids of the SAME real-world institution's own actor record in a sibling state-curriculum repo (e.g. NCSE, Discovery Institute, and the ACLU each appear independently in 2-3 of these repos, since each repo was founded in its own session before any of them existed to cross-reference). Deliberately free-text, not a validated cross-repo link -- same informal-reference discipline this ecosystem already uses for ConceptBase/CompetencyBase/bio-core-k12 ids (see CONTRIBUTING.md), just applied to actor identity across sibling LPM repos instead of to a different base repo. Format: '<repo>:<that repo's own actor id>', e.g. 'pennsylvania-lpm:PALP-ACTOR-ncse'. See curriculum-sources/README.md and curriculum-sources/cross-repo-notes/ for the synthesized, connected narrative these cross-references point at.
